notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes: [p]This update contains new Pomodoro App, fixed nightstands center points and some minor fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]• New Pomodoro App. Set up your goals and time to complete with the rewards you want to receive![/p][p]• Fixed all nightstands issue with them not being centered. Might require to replace them slightly on your current save files[/p][p]• Minor fixes[/p]
